statement: The complete preregistered small, simple, uniform-access, no-reuse, update-heavy, and alternative-favored control matrix produces valid paired capacity, resource, cost, uncertainty, and practical-effect evidence for every cell regardless of which architecture wins.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
Do not seal this Quest until benchmark-statistical-capacity-protocol and benchmark-whole-topology-resource-accounting are terminal.
Closure requires valid evidence or explicit non-measuring classification for every preregistered cell and never requires Lagrange to win.
Apply the harness-fidelity attack checklist and retain immutable raw artifacts plus live engagement evidence for each measured matrix identity.
